messages.author: dana.bramley.100179@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the new chapter space for the British Isles. Let us use this for local chapter news and coordinating upcoming tastings.

messages.author: dana.ellery.101032@homestead.example
messages.text: Thanks Casey. We are lining up the autumn meet-up in Cork. Hoping to have a solid turnout from the local makers this year.

messages.author: eric.ryder.100705@dvorakfarmstead.example
messages.text: Ludlow is seeing strong demand for aged cheddars as we head into the winter markets. Good to see steady growth across the board.

messages.author: dana.bramley.100179@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Given the current health situation, ICF staff are helping us transition our spring tastings and workshops to online sessions.

messages.author: dana.ellery.101032@homestead.example
messages.text: The virtual grading course went surprisingly well yesterday. Thanks to everyone who dialed in and helped troubleshoot the connection.

messages.author: eric.ryder.100705@dvorakfarmstead.example
messages.text: Is anyone planning to participate in the virtual symposium next month? Amelia has been putting together a great track on affineur techniques.

messages.author: nora.bramley.101858@mistlebrookcreamery.example
messages.text: We are still waiting to see if regional meetings will return to in-person formats by next year. Hard to plan production schedules without clarity.

messages.author: dana.bramley.100179@bluebarn.example
messages.text: In-person events are finally back on the calendar and competition entries for the summer fair are already exceeding our initial projections.

messages.author: dana.ellery.101032@homestead.example
messages.text: Capacity at the autumn venue is nearly maxed out. We might need to cap registration for the afternoon masterclasses.

messages.author: eric.ryder.100705@dvorakfarmstead.example
messages.text: Demand for artisan blocks remains high through the spring. We are currently trying to secure additional storage for the upcoming batches.

messages.author: elisa.ferraro.102241@vandermolenfarmstead.example
messages.text: Up here in Ayrshire, sales are steady but packaging costs continue to creep up. Have any other makers found alternative suppliers lately?

messages.author: dana.bramley.100179@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Our conference sponsorship is holding firm, though the events team reports that logistics are quite stretched this season.

messages.author: dana.ellery.101032@homestead.example
messages.text: The sheer volume of competition submissions this year means we need extra volunteers for the grading tables.

messages.author: eric.ryder.100705@dvorakfarmstead.example
messages.text: Cost inflation is really biting into margins this winter. I am glad ICF has hardship dues relief in place for members who need it.

messages.author: nora.bramley.101858@mistlebrookcreamery.example
messages.text: We are sadly seeing a few smaller local creameries struggle with succession planning right now. We should organize a discussion on how to help.

messages.author: dana.bramley.100179@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Costs are finally easing up a bit across the board. The big topic for our chapter right now is the modernization of raw milk aging rules.

messages.author: eric.ryder.100705@dvorakfarmstead.example
messages.text: The new traceability guidelines are straightforward, but implementing the digital logs will take some time for our affineurs to get used to.

messages.author: dana.ellery.101032@homestead.example
messages.text: Let us wrap up the agenda for the upcoming autumn meet-up. I will share the final schedule once ICF staff confirm the venue details.
